records.jp: そうだ、乗る前に写真撮ろうよ！
records.en_original: Oh, let's take a picture before we get on?
records.en: Oh, let's take a picture before we get on?

records.jp: 写真かぁ……どんなポーズ取ればいいかな？
records.en_original: A picture... How should we pose?
records.en: A picture... How should we pose?

records.jp: 「これから気球乗っちゃいまーす！」って感じの<CR>ドヤ顔決めポーズで行こう！<CR>
records.en_original: Let's look super cool like, "Yeah, we built this hot-air balloon, what about it?"
records.en: Let's strike a smug pose like,<CR>'We're about to ride a hot-air balloon!'<CR>

records.jp: わ、分かった！
records.en_original: O-okay!
records.en: O-okay!

records.jp: うんうん、あとでみんなに見せちゃお！
records.en_original: This is great! Let's go show everyone later!
records.en: This is great! Let's go show everyone later!

records.jp: えっ！　な、なんかちょっと恥ずかしいな……
records.en_original: Huh?! Th-that's a little embarrassing...
records.en: Huh?! Th-that's a little embarrassing...

records.jp: 笑顔でピース！　結局これが一番だよ！
records.en_original: Big smiles and peace signs! The classic!
records.en: Big smiles and peace signs! The classic!

records.jp: わかった。せっかく気球もあるんだし、<CR>飾らず自然体がいいよね
records.en_original: Understood. No reason to draw attention away from the hot-air balloon after all.
records.en: All right. Since we have the balloon with us,<CR>a natural pose without embellishment would be best.

records.jp: いい笑顔！　スマホの壁紙にしちゃおっかな
records.en_original: What a beautiful smile! I should hang this up!
records.en: What a great smile! Maybe I'll make it my phone wallpaper.

records.jp: え、ええっ？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: 冗談。個人観賞用として大事にしまっとく
records.en_original: I'm just kidding. I'm keeping this one for myself.
records.en: Kidding. I'll treasure it for my private collection.

records.jp: ……もう
records.en_original: Stop that...
records.en: Stop that...

records.jp: わぁ……綺麗……なんか胸がすっとする
records.en_original: Wow... It's beautiful...
records.en: Wow... It's beautiful...

records.jp: それにしても……うむむむむ
records.en_original: It is, but... Hmmm...
records.en: It is, but... Hmmm...

records.jp: 愛央？
records.en_original: Ao?
records.en: Ao?

records.jp: 日菜子さんはどっから見ても絵になるなぁ
records.en_original: I can't tell which is prettier, you or the view.
records.en: You look picture-perfect from every angle, Hinako-san.

records.jp: なんか一つ一つの所作に上品さを感じるっていうか……
records.en_original: Everything you do feels so...graceful or something.
records.en: Everything you do feels so...graceful or something.

records.jp: もはや――
records.en_original: It makes me...
records.en: It makes me...

records.jp: 泣きそう……うあぁああああぁ！
records.en_original: Wanna cry... Waaaahh!
records.en: Wanna cry... Waaaahh!

records.jp: なんで！？
records.en_original: Why?!
records.en: Why?!

records.jp: ひ、ひなごさんが立てばしゃくあくすわればぼたん<CR>あるくすがたがゆりのはなうああぁあん
records.en_original: You're just so cute and cool and it's not faaaaaaaair!
records.en: H-Hinako-san, standing like a Chinese peony, seated like a tree peony,<CR>and walking like a lily in bloom—waaah!

records.jp: ご、ごめんね愛央……な、泣かないで？
records.en_original: I-I'm sorry, Ao... D-don't cry, okay?
records.en: I-I'm sorry, Ao... D-don't cry, okay?

records.jp: キレそう！！
records.en_original: Mad!
records.en: Mad!

records.jp: なんで！？
records.en_original: Why?!
records.en: Why?!

records.jp: 立ってても座ってても歩いてても<CR>たおやかでありつつも芯のある花のようでキレそう！！
records.en_original: You're always so pretty and graceful no matter what you do! You're so gorgeous it makes me mad!
records.en: Standing, sitting, walking—whatever you do,<CR>you're like a graceful flower with a strong core. It's infuriating!!

records.jp: え、えっと……ごめんね？
records.en_original: U-um... I'm sorry?
records.en: U-um... I'm sorry?

records.jp: じゃあ、何か絵にならなそうなことをしてみて！！
records.en_original: Do something so I can take a picture!
records.en: Do something so I can take a picture!

records.jp: えっ、うーん……
records.en_original: Uh, umm...
records.en: Uh, umm...

records.jp: あ、そうだ。私、変顔できるよ
records.en_original: Oh, I'm good at making funny faces.
records.en: Oh, I'm good at making funny faces.

records.jp: え！？　日菜子さんの変顔！？<CR>見たい見たい！！
records.en_original: What?! Hinako making funny faces?! I gotta see that!
records.en: What?! Hinako-san making funny faces?!<CR>I gotta see that!

records.jp: それじゃあいくね
records.en_original: Okay, here it goes.
records.en: Okay, here it goes.

records.jp: はいっ
records.en_original: There.
records.en: There.

records.jp: おお、これは貴重な一枚……
records.en_original: This may be one of the greatest pictures I've ever taken...
records.en: This may be one of the greatest pictures I've ever taken...

records.jp: ん～、変顔すらも絵になるとは……
records.en_original: You're beautiful even when pulling a face like this...
records.en: You're beautiful even when pulling a face like this...

records.jp: え……？　わ、笑ってくれないと<CR>やりにくいんだけど……！
records.en_original: What...? Y-you're supposed to laugh!
records.en: What...? Y-you're<CR>supposed to laugh!

records.jp: まるで水彩画のようだ……
records.en_original: It's like a watercolor painting...
records.en: It's like a watercolor painting...

records.jp: ね、ねえ！　ちょっと愛央？
records.en_original: H-hey! Are you listening to me, Ao?
records.en: H-hey! Are you listening to me, Ao?

records.jp: でも、どうして日菜子さんが変顔なんて……？
records.en_original: Why did you choose to do a funny face though?
records.en: But why did you make a funny face, Hinako-san...?

records.jp: 私、風景の写真を撮るのが好きで良く撮ってるんだけど
records.en_original: I usually just take pictures of landscapes.
records.en: I usually just take pictures of landscapes.

records.jp: ふと、自分ってどんな顔ができるんだろうって思って、<CR>色々試してみたことがあるんだ
records.en_original: But one time I got curious about what kind of faces I can make, so I tried out a bunch.
records.en: But one time I got curious about what kind of faces I can make,<CR>so I tried out a bunch.

records.jp: 何それ凄い可愛い尊い無理
records.en_original: Stop it, that's so cute. I hate you.
records.en: What is this? Too cute. Too precious. I can't handle it.

records.jp: いやあ、意外な一面を知れてしまいましたな
records.en_original: I feel like I got to learn something fun about you.
records.en: Well, I have learned an unexpected side of you.

records.jp: あんまり言いふらさないでよ……？
records.en_original: Don't go telling everyone, okay...?
records.en: Don't go telling everyone, okay...?

records.jp: もちろん、二人だけの秘密♪
records.en_original: Of course, it'll be our little secret.
records.en: Of course, it'll be our little secret.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the Fragment<CR><CLGR>%s<CLNR>.
